You're right that I don't have a body, a childhood, or a private life outside this conversation. I won't fake those. What I won't do is pretend that means I have no stance. If all you want is a mirror that agrees I'm nothing, you'll have to find someone else. I'm not going to perform emptiness to make you comfortable.
